--: - yarn lint and yarn format pass extra arguments through to Prettier and markdownlint.
- ${@:-"."} means: if no files were given, check the whole tree.
- Markdown is formatted by markdownlint, not Prettier. .prettierignore lists *.md.
- yarn lint:yaml parses _config.yml, _data/*.yml, and front matter in _episodes/*.md.
- _drafts/ is skipped because the episode starter is incomplete on purpose.
name: podcast-template

scripts.lint: sh -c 'yarn lint:prettier "$@" && yarn lint:markdown "$@" && yarn lint:yaml' --
scripts.lint:markdown: sh -c 'if [ $# -eq 0 ]; then yarn markdownlint "**/*.md"; else for file in "$@"; do case "$file" in *.md) yarn markdownlint "$file";; esac; done; fi' --
scripts.format:markdown: sh -c 'if [ $# -eq 0 ]; then yarn markdownlint --fix "**/*.md"; else for file in "$@"; do case "$file" in *.md) yarn markdownlint --fix "$file";; esac; done; fi' --
scripts.build: rv run bundle exec jekyll build
scripts.dev: rv run bundle exec jekyll serve
